caption: The video captures a low-angle view of a tattooed player in red shorts and black knee sleeves dribbling on an outdoor court. A green fence, trees, apartment blocks, a hoop, and a parked car sit behind him. The dark basketball is already in motion at the first frame, blurred as it drops near the right hand before leaving the view while the arm keeps pumping. The legs stay spread in a wide stance as the ball re-enters from the right edge and sweeps across toward the left, the reaching hand tracking it. It is then controlled high on the left, pressed by the fingers, before being driven back toward the center and right. The background slides progressively leftward, indicating a tracking pan. The dribbling remains ongoing as the clip ends.
